title: Royal Botanical Replication
description: DataPack that adds the ability to replicate plants from mods by using the mixer from Create Mod
body:
For a long time, I used the Botanical Replication datapack by VoodooBeard and loved it. Unfortunately, it stopped working in my world, so I decided to create my own version with a twist. Instead of using a crafting table, you must now mix bone meal, rotten flesh, and the target plant in a mixer from the Create mod. The data pack mame is inspired by The Royal Botanical Gardens in Kew. 

I haven’t included every plant; I feel that plants which can already be easily farmed shouldn't be eligible for replication. This pack is specifically designed for those rare plants that you want a lot of, but would otherwise have to destroy their natural habitat to obtain.

## Compatibility:
In addition to vanilla plants, I have added support for the following mods:

- Farmer's Delight
- Nature's Spirit

## Requirements:
- Create Mod
